28:71.text: : "Tell me! If Allâh made the night continuous for you till the Day of Resurrection, which ilâh
besides Allâh could bring you light? Will you not then hear?"

28:72.text: : "Tell me! If Allâh made the day continuous for you till the Day of Resurrection, which ilâh
besides Allâh could bring you night wherein you rest? Will you not then see?"

28:73.text: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein
and that you may seek of His Bounty
- and in order that you may be grateful.

28:75.text: And We shall take out from every nation a witness, and We shall say: "Bring your proof." Then they shall know that the truth is with Allâh
which they invented will disappear from them.

28:77.text: which Allâh has bestowed on you, the home of the Hereafter, and forget not your portion of lawful enjoyment in this world; and do good as Allâh has been good to you, and seek not mischief in the land. Verily, Allâh likes not the Mufsidûn
(those who commit great crimes and sins, oppressors, tyrants, mischief-makers, corrupters)
